subject: English
question_text: Put the following parts of the story in correct order to
stimulus: rewrite the whole story. 1×8=8 (a) Being annoyed, the master bought a cat to kill the mice. SSC English (b) All the mice thanked the young mouse for his plan. (c) A young mouse rose to speak and he said, `Let's tie a bell round the cat's neck'. (d) As a result, they could not move freely as before. (e) Then a old mouse said, 'It's good but who will tie the bell?' (f) They held a meeting to find out a way to be free from the danger. (g) At this all remained silent and none come forward. (h) A number of mice were doing a lot of mischief in an old house of a master. R Section B : Writing Test (Marks 50)
